title: Testing my new blog editor
summary: GitHub hosts my blog for free!
content:
I made a new convenient way of editing and adding new posts keeping this site as a static page for free GitHub hosting.
It consists on a python script with a GUI where i can manage and edit app my posts. It also has a **rich** *text* `editor`!
